column1: Is Your AP CSA Score Good?

Yes — a 5 is excellent. Only 25.5% of the 93,906 students who took AP CSA in 2025 scored a 5. Nationally, a 5 demonstrates mastery equivalent to an A in a college-level CS1 course. Nearly every university that grants AP CS credit awards the maximum benefit for a 5, often including placement into CS2 or above.

Yes — a 4 is strong. In 2025, 21.8% of test-takers scored a 4. It is ""Well Qualified"" per College Board standards and earns introductory CS credit at most universities. A 4 demonstrates solid command of Java fundamentals, OOP concepts, and data structures. Most students with a 4 needed 27–34 MCQ correct and solid FRQ performance.

A 3 is passing and ""Qualified"" per College Board. In 2025, 19.8% of students scored a 3. It earns credit at many schools, though selective CS programs often require a 4 or 5. A 3 means you demonstrated competency across core Java concepts. If your target school requires a 4+, use a 3 as motivation — the gap is bridgeable with focused preparation in the specific FRQ types you missed.
